invariants.claim: Every canonical backend refresh response is no-store and carries exactly rotated, not_rotated, rejected, or outcome_unknown.
A status without an exact consistent outcome marker never proves that rotation did not commit.
The BFF preserves cookies only for exact not_rotated responses on the closed 400, 500, or 503 matrix.
Rejected, outcome_unknown, missing, invalid, intermediary, transport, and malformed post-rotation outcomes clear locally without refresh retry.
Only a rotated 200 whose body, JWT, identity, and cookie lifetimes all validate replaces the access and refresh pair.
Credential-bearing authentication requests do not follow upstream redirects.
Refresh and logout use one origin-scoped exclusive Web Lock, and unsupported locks refuse refresh before fetch.
One same-window refresh promise performs exactly one refresh fetch and has no automatic retry path.
Cross-tab session messages use a fixed versioned schema and contain no credential, identity, permission, or entitlement data.
Logout redirects and broadcasts session end only after the BFF confirms local cookie clearing.
Authenticated customer mobile/desktop actions, both active admin chrome variants, the connected-wallet hook, and admin denial actions delegate to the shared session controller.
Browser and BFF changes contain no permission, plan, ranking-offset, feature-flag, subscription, or entitlement authority.

anchors: two tab realms serialize refresh through one origin lock
cross-tab delivery reconstructs the closed event and redirects only the receiver
refresh and logout use the same exclusive lock
missing Web Locks refuses refresh before network I/O
refresh transport ambiguity ends the session only after confirmed local clearing
BroadcastChannel failures degrade to same-tab events without breaking auth
delegated authenticated-header logout click uses the shared controller
broadcast messages contain only the closed token-free schema
authenticated AdminShell must expose the shared logout controller hook
only for an exact backend-authored `not_rotated` outcome

residualStops.claim: No accepted real-browser matrix proves Web Locks, BroadcastChannel, cookie application, navigation, or multi-tab behavior.
No proxy or browser fault injection proves timeout or reset behavior after backend commit.
No PostgreSQL exercise proves consume, replay response, commit acknowledgement ambiguity, or family-lock ordering.
A disconnect after backend rotation but before Set-Cookie delivery still forces reauthentication and has no receipt or idempotency protocol.
JavaScript cannot prove clearing HttpOnly cookies while the BFF itself is unreachable.
The shared refresh controller has no automatic customer/admin runtime caller, so expired-cookie recovery still requires explicit reauthentication.
Already-issued access tokens remain valid until expiry after logout or family revocation.
No production browser, proxy, TLS, routing, canary, rollback, deployment, database, secret, or service action is authorized by this contract.
